ns0:svg.ns0:desc: Original two-state model. Attachment takes fraction from detached 1 minus A at rate f times 1 minus A; detachment returns fraction at rate g times A. Both fluxes have units per second. Total fraction is one.
ns0:svg.ns0:title: Attached and detached fractions
